name: DoAr 24 E

images.wavelength_label: 880 um continuum (pre-ALMA SMA); E + IRC binary pair

paper.title: Protoplanetary Disk Structures in Ophiuchus. II. Extension to Fainter Sources

images.note: ODISEA object 037 (SSTc2d J162623.4-242101 = GSS 31 / DoAr 24E) A+B: discs around both components; A marginally resolved (109x61 mas, 20.32 mJy), B point-like (17.24 mJy, circled) ~2.1 arcsec SE of A. First ALMA mm record for this system (atlas held only SMA 880 um).

paper.title: The Ophiuchus DIsc Survey Employing ALMA (ODISEA) - I: project description and continuum images at 28 au resolution

notes: Binary in Ophiuchus: the optically visible primary DoAr 24 E and its infrared companion (DoAr 24E IRC) show roughly equal 880 um emission, both imaged in the pre-ALMA SMA survey (Andrews et al. 2010).
